title: Add the exit-evidence report and a report-only method gate
summary: Two new scripts read a repository's work records and only report. exit-evidence.mjs lists each closed task as evidenced, exempt, refused, inconclusive, stale, no evidence or unknown, from the observation records that name it. method-gate.mjs runs it with the ceiling report and says how many of its two rules were evaluated. Neither blocks: they exit 0 for findings, so read the position that starts each line. The ia:work skill says how to record evidence in the right order; the README shows the gate in CI.
